facts.claim: A molasses storage tank burst in Boston's North End on January 15, 1919.
The tank held about 2.3 million US gallons of molasses.

sources.title: 100 years ago today: Molasses crashes through Boston's North End

facts.claim: The tank was about 50 feet tall.
